item.title: KeyTypist 2.5.0
item.description:
KeyWeave is now KeyTypist. This release renames the app and gives it its own identity and update feed.
- Renamed from KeyWeave: new app name, icons and bundle identifier (dev.anuhas.keytypist). The GitHub repository is now DevAnuhas/keytypist; old links redirect. - KeyTypist is a new app to macOS. Install it manually, then grant Accessibility, Input Monitoring and (if you use it) Screen Recording again. - Nothing is migrated from KeyWeave. Settings, learned writing, downloaded models and sync data stay in KeyWeave's folders, and KeyTypist starts fresh with its own. - KeyWeave 2.4.0 and earlier cannot update to this release in place and keep reading their own frozen update feed. They will not be offered it and are not affected. - KeyTypist checks its own signed update feed daily. Installing an update always requires your action; turn scheduled checks off in About.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Complete Cotypist Pro/Labs parity is unfinished.
